name: jmeter-lab
postCreateCommand: mkdir -p /home/vscode/jmeter plans results data && curl -fSL --retry 3 -o /tmp/apache-jmeter-5.6.3.tgz https://archive.apache.org/dist/jmeter/binaries/apache-jmeter-5.6.3.tgz && tar -xzf /tmp/apache-jmeter-5.6.3.tgz -C /home/vscode/jmeter --strip-components=1 && touch plans/.gitkeep results/.gitkeep data/.gitkeep && /home/vscode/jmeter/bin/jmeter -v
